svg.title: System3: native System1 and System2 coordination in DSH
svg.desc: Target architecture, not an implemented automatic loop. DSH owns Session, permissions, budgets and execution. System2 plans and generates. A native decision runtime projects evidence, applies rules, asks System1 only for bounded semantic decisions, and commits allowed actions. Current foundations include the DSH runtime, typed Jev provider and explicit shadow receipts. Agent JEV Pilot is an experimental reference, not a code dependency.

g.aria-label: System3 = System1 decision intelligence + System2 reasoning and generation
g.title: System3 = System1 decision intelligence + System2 reasoning and generation

g.aria-label: TARGET DESIGN / Automatic coordination is proposed, not enabled today.
g.title: TARGET DESIGN / Automatic coordination is proposed, not enabled today.

g.title: DSH NATIVE COORDINATION / Existing lifecycle first; integration proposed

g.aria-label: System1 is used when rules leave meaningful uncertainty and a full generation is too costly.
g.title: System1 is used when rules leave meaningful uncertainty and a full generation is too costly.

g.aria-label: Abstain or request deeper System2 reasoning when evidence or confidence is insufficient.
